summary: Backend pytest suite (14 cases) targeting the 'configurable tips per cashier' feature. 10 passed / 4 failed. 3 CRITICAL backend bugs found that block end-to-end persistence: (1) Business model is missing `default_tip_percent` field on GET/PUT — so SettingsPage save is silently dropped; (2) update_cashier endpoint does not write `default_tip_percent` even though CashierUpdate model accepts it — so cashier override is silently dropped; (3) Legacy POST /api/orders without `subtotal` returns 500 (Order.subtotal is required float but OrderCreate.subtotal defaults to None) — regression against offline-mode baseline. Endpoints that work: POST /api/cashiers with default_tip_percent (create-time only), POST /api/orders with tip+subtotal, GET /api/orders returns tip+subtotal, GET /api/stats/daily returns total_tips, GET /api/stats/cashier-tips returns sorted ranking. Frontend code inspection confirms all required data-testids are present (tips-config-card, default-tip-input, tip-preset-{0,10,15,20}, save-tip-button, cashier-tip-input, cashier-tip-badge-{id}, checkout-tip-section, tip-mode-percent/custom, tip-percent-*, tip-custom-input, checkout-subtotal/tip/total, confirm-checkout-button, stat-tips-card, stat-total-tips, cashier-tip-ranking). E2E UI flow could not be validated against the live preview because Playwright login submission flaked (form filled but not submitted/navigated); however backend defects above will surface in the UI regardless (Settings reload will show the saved % vanish; cashier edit won't change badge after reload).

critical.issue: Business + BusinessUpdate Pydantic models do NOT declare `default_tip_percent`. GET response omits the field; PUT request silently drops it. Frontend SettingsPage will appear to save 15% but a reload returns nothing. Fix: add `default_tip_percent: Optional[float] = 0` to both Business and BusinessUpdate models in /app/backend/server.py (around lines 120-133).

update_cashier in /app/backend/server.py (lines 801-821) never copies `default_tip_percent` into update_data. The Pydantic model CashierUpdate has the field, but the handler only writes name/pin/password_hash/active. Result: cashier override cannot be changed after creation. Fix: add `if update.default_tip_percent is not None or 'default_tip_percent' in update.dict(exclude_unset=True): update_data['default_tip_percent'] = update.default_tip_percent` (and handle null-clear via exclude_unset).

OrderCreate.subtotal is Optional[float] = None, but Order.subtotal is `float = 0.0` (non-Optional). When a legacy payload (no subtotal) is posted, `Order(**order.dict())` passes subtotal=None and Pydantic raises -> 500 Internal Server Error. Regression vs iteration_8 baseline. Fix: either default OrderCreate.subtotal to 0.0 (and compute subtotal=total-tip when missing), or change Order.subtotal to Optional[float], or sanitize in create_order before model build.

minor.issue: Because of bug #2 above and the `update.default_tip_percent is not None` filter pattern used elsewhere, clearing back to global (null) is not supported even if bug #2 is fixed naively. Recommend using `model_dump(exclude_unset=True)` to distinguish 'omitted' from 'explicit null'.
Endpoint groups by cashier_id including '__none__' bucket for orders without cashier_id. Recommend filtering out the unassigned bucket from the ranking or labelling clearly in API contract.

integration_issues.issue: PUT payload includes default_tip_percent but the backend Business/BusinessUpdate models drop the field. Toast may show success but reload reverts. End-user impact: feature appears broken.

PUT /api/cashiers/{id} ignores default_tip_percent server-side. Badge cashier-tip-badge-{id} will not update on next list refresh after edit (it WILL appear correctly for newly-created cashiers because POST persists it).

playwright_blockers: Login form fill+click on https://resto-pos-hub-11.preview.emergentagent.com/login worked the first time during pytest (POST /api/auth/restaurant/login 200 in backend logs) but two Playwright sessions in this iteration could not transition past /login after fill. Form fields were populated (password dots visible) yet click on 'Entrar' did not navigate. May be a React-Hook-Form vs Playwright .fill() timing issue (input event not dispatched). Recommend adding type=submit form binding + verify via Enter key. Did not block backend testing.

action_items: Add `default_tip_percent: Optional[float] = 0` to Business and BusinessUpdate Pydantic models, then wire it through update_business handler (the current update_data filter already accepts new keys).
Update update_cashier handler to write `default_tip_percent` from CashierUpdate (use `update.dict(exclude_unset=True)` to support null/clear-to-global semantics).
Fix legacy POST /api/orders 500: either default OrderCreate.subtotal to 0.0 OR compute `subtotal = total - tip` server-side when missing OR make Order.subtotal Optional.
After backend fixes: re-run /app/backend/tests/test_tips_feature.py and validate /settings UI saves & persists, /cashiers edit updates badge after reload, and POS checkout-tip flow end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: Business model and BusinessUpdate were not extended for the new default_tip_percent field; the rest of the feature (stats, order persistence, cashier create-time field) is implemented but the global setting is unreachable. Treat as an incomplete migration.

server.py update_cashier: pattern of `if update.field is not None: update_data[...] = ...` does not allow clearing to null. The newly-added optional `default_tip_percent` (null = use global) requires `exclude_unset=True` to distinguish 'omitted' from 'explicit null'. Other fields (active=False would be wrong here too; active is bool not Optional, so fine).

server.py Order vs OrderCreate type mismatch on `subtotal` (required float vs Optional[float]) is a known footgun — running `Order(**order.dict())` crashes whenever the client omits subtotal. This is a regression vs the offline-mode baseline where legacy payloads worked.

Frontend wiring is correct: all data-testids declared per problem statement are present in SettingsPage, CashiersPage, POSPage, StatsPage. The cashier session in CashierGate.jsx and tip math (subtotal * pct / 100) in POSPage.jsx are correctly delineated by testids.

rca of the issue: Feature was implemented in two layers but the Business global-tip layer was forgotten on the backend. (1) SettingsPage.jsx calls PUT /api/business {default_tip_percent: 15} → FastAPI parses into BusinessUpdate which IGNORES unknown fields (no extras='allow') → only declared fields land in update_data → MongoDB document is updated with {} → GET returns Business model which also omits the field → frontend shows blank on reload. (2) CashiersPage edit calls PUT /api/cashiers/{id} {default_tip_percent: 20} → CashierUpdate model HAS the field so the body is parsed correctly → but update_cashier handler hand-crafts update_data and never copies that key → Mongo document untouched → cashier list still returns old value. (3) Order subtotal model mismatch: Order.subtotal: float = 0.0 (required) vs OrderCreate.subtotal: Optional[float] = None — passing None through `Order(**order.dict())` triggers Pydantic ValidationError → 500. Reproduce all three by running `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_tips_feature.py -v`.
